question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He is usually calm but today he appears rather ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "disturbed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Disturbed" **means having mental or emotional problems. (मानसिक समस्‍याओं से ग्रस्‍त)

 
 
• **Example**: *He wrote a book on the treatment of emotionally **disturbed**__ children.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that he seems a little perturbed today.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct sentence**: *He is usually calm but today he appears rather __**disturbed**__. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Quiet: **with very little or no noise. (शांत, ख़ामोश)
 
• **Undisturbed: **not moved or touched by anyone or anything. (जिसे किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु ने अपने स्‍थान से न हटाया या न छुआ, यथास्‍थान या व्‍यवस्थित, अछूता)
 
• **Relaxed: **not worried or tense. (तनावमुक्त, निश्चिंत,बेफ़िक्र)
